  • Approximately 50% travel on client site and to our European offices
  • Develop a commanding knowledge of Cognite’s solutions and how they uniquely drive value realization with your customers

The Impact you bring to Cognite

  • Detail oriented, high-energy sales professional with strong relationship-building skills and a focus on delighting customers in every phase of our engagements
  • Proven experience selling at C-Level both in business and IT
  • Specific experience in selling SaaS solutions, cloud deployments  and subscription pricing model, commanding a deep understanding of software sales processes and terminology including ARR, NRR, TCV and Services Bookings
  • Self-starter, able to work in a team environment, and superb time management and prioritization skills
  • Excellent communication skills, including stellar presentation skills

Required Qualifications and Preferred Experiences 

  • 3+ years successful Software Sales Experience into Life Sciences/Pharma companies is required (Pharma, Bio-Pharma and Contract Manufacturing, Medical Devices and Medical Products)
  • 3+ years of direct sales experience carrying and exceeding a quota and selling enterprise software/ software-as-a-service (Business Intelligence/ Data Warehouse/ Big Data/ Advanced Analytics/ Machine Learning/Automation/Operational Technology) to C-level executives

description:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Location: Omega, WA5 3TP (3 days) / Icon 1, WA15 0AF (1 day) / WFH (1 day)

About THG Manufacturing

THG Manufacturing is the dedicated, high-growth contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing division of THG PLC. Operating from state-of-the-art, BRCGS-accredited manufacturing facilities globally, we partner with prestigious household names and global powerhouse brands who trust us to formulate, produce, and scale their product ranges.

Our specialised manufacturing capabilities include:

  • Powder Blending (sports nutrition, lifestyle powders, functional health formulations)
  • Tablets & Capsules (vitamins, minerals, and dietary supplements)
  • Protein Bar Manufacturing (extruded, layered, and premium enrobed formats)
  • Fruit Preparations & Concentrates (aseptic processing and clean-label infusions)

An Unrivaled Growth Trajectory

This is an exceptional time to join our division. THG Manufacturing achieved 300% growth this year, is forecast to deliver another 100% growth next year, and is firmly on track to expand into a £100 million division within 5 years purely in co-manufacturing. Global powerhouse brands trust us under multi-year co-manufacturing agreements, validating our industry credibility, technical excellence, and manufacturing reliability.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised, proactive, and customer-focused Account Liaison Officer to join our fast-paced co-manufacturing division, reporting directly into the Commercial Director.

In this role, you will serve as the primary operational conduit between our valued external co-manufacturing partners and internal site functions, including Production, Planning, Logistics, and Quality. You will drive day-to-day operational execution, clear customer communication, and end-to-end order tracking—ensuring customer forecasts, purchase orders, production timelines, and stock reconciliations run smoothly from inception through to dispatch.

As an Account Liaison Officer you will:

Customer Liaison & Communication

  • Operational Point of Contact: Act as the first port of call for day-to-day customer enquiries regarding production updates, lead times, batch progress, and dispatch schedules.
  • Customer Updates & Reviews: Prepare and participate in regular operational update calls with customers, providing transparent visibility on open order status and delivery milestones.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with internal factory teams (Planning, Production, Materials Management, Quality, and Dispatch) to ensure client requirements are understood and executed smoothly.
  • Escalation Support: Promptly raise and track operational bottlenecks or supply chain escalations with internal stakeholders and the Commercial Director, keeping customers proactively informed of resolutions.

Demand, Supply & Production Coordination

  • Demand Planning Interface: Collate customer demand forecasts and align them with internal planners to assess production line capacity and material requirements.
  • Supply Planning & OTIF Monitoring: Track component and raw material deliveries to support target On-Time, In-Full (OTIF) manufacturing schedules.
  • Production & Kitting Schedules: Liaise with site operational teams across our powder blending, bar, tableting, and fruit preparation plants to monitor kitting activities and scheduled production runs.
  • Supply Health Tracking: Support regular supply health and risk reporting, flagging potential raw material or component shortages before they impact production plans.

Order Processing & Systems Administration

  • Order Processing: Accurately translate customer purchase orders into production and planning schedules across THG’s planning systems.
  • THG Ingenuity Systems: Raise, monitor, and coordinate production orders within THG’s proprietary Ingenuity platform.
  • B2B Portal & Price List Set-Up: Assist with setting up customer price lists on the THGB2B portal and ensure quarterly pricing uploads and system adjustments are maintained accurately in line with agreed terms.
  • New Product Range Administration: Assist in setting up initial reporting suites, tracking master SKU data, and ensuring data alignment for new product range introductions.

Inventory Reconciliation & Operational Control

  • Free-Issued Stock Reconciliation: Perform regular reconciliations of customer-supplied (free-issued) raw materials, packaging, and ingredients, tracking usage, investigating discrepancies, and reporting remaining balances.
  • Finance & Timings Alignment: Provide timely order movement and production timing updates to the Commercial Director and Finance teams to support revenue tracking and month-end financial reviews.

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience in a customer service, client liaison, supply chain coordination, account coordination, or production administration role (ideally within FMCG, food & beverage, packaging, or manufacturing).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to maintain clear, professional, and positive customer relationships.
  • High accuracy in order processing, stock reconciliation, and maintaining system data.
  • Basic understanding of production workflows, material lead times, and supply chain processes.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, reporting spreadsheets) and comfort working with ERP, MRP, or proprietary ordering portals.

Desirable Attributes

  • Prior experience working within contract manufacturing (co-man) or third-party client operations.
  • Familiarity with food, nutrition, or pharmaceutical manufacturing standards (e.g., BRCGS, GMP).

Working Pattern & Office Locations

Collaboration and close proximity to our manufacturing plants are essential to our operational velocity. This role follows a hybrid model (4 days on-site / 1 day remote):

  • 3 Days per week: THG Omega Campus, Warrington (flagship operational & manufacturing campus)
  • 1 Day per week: Icon 1, Manchester Airport (THG Global Headquarters)
  • 1 Day per week: Flexible Work from Home (WFH)

What's in it for me?

Career Development

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year.
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

Wellbeing Support

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.
  • Access to our on-site physio.

Other Perks

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.
  • On-site staff shop.
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

description: Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Europe's plants run on gas, power, heat and steam – and all of them are being rebuilt at the same time. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) answer these questions with our Energy OS: a digital twin of the site, an optimizer that plans it, and agents that operate it. The optimizer is yours. Twenty-year investment decisions, quarter-hourly dispatch, real tariffs, real market rules. You report directly to the CTO – and nobody stands between your model and the plant it runs on. Tasks Optimization Models End-to-End: Own capacity expansion planning over multi-year horizons, dispatch at quarter-hour resolution, and MIP production scheduling with sequence-dependent setup times. Model Physics & Contracts: Storage, thermal networks, transmission, flexibility, self-consumption, minimum part loads, start-up costs – formulate what reality actually demands. Make It Solve: Tighten big-Ms, scale models cleanly, decide where decomposition earns its complexity – and where it doesn't. Smart Data Reduction: Time series clustering, extreme periods, segmentation and aggregation – without accuracy quietly disappearing. Regulation into Constraints: Model grid fees, levies, tariffs, balancing power and intraday trading per country, and understand what they do to the objective function. Prove It's Right: Test cases on real customer systems, fixtures that catch regressions, and infeasibility output an engineer can actually diagnose. Interface & Production: Define inputs and outputs with the Product Engineers; own the runs on Kubernetes – solve time, memory and cost are your numbers. Explain to the Customer: When a customer questions a schedule, you're the one who can say why the model chose it. Optimization: Deep familiarity with LP and MILP and the craft around it – formulation strength, relaxations, warm starts, solver behavior. Ce que vous ferez

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital.

  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.

Chez Deliveroo, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets concrets ayant un impact direct sur des millions de clients.

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous bénéficierez :

  • D'un environnement collaboratif où l'autonomie, l'innovation et l'apprentissage sont encouragés.

  • D'une expérience au sein d'une entreprise technologique internationale en constante évolution.

 

Notre processus de recrutement

Notre objectif est de vous permettre de montrer votre potentiel dans les meilleures conditions.

Le processus comprend généralement :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition.

  • Un entretien avec le manager de l'équipe Fidélisation pour échanger sur vos motivations, votre façon de travailler et découvrir davantage l'équipe.

Construire un environnement où chacun a sa place

Chez Deliveroo, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes fait notre force. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, quelles que soient l'origine, le genre, l'âge, le handicap, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, les convictions ou le parcours.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Internal Fraud Database 

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.  For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

Working for the Civil Service

À propos d'Artefact Adopt AI

Chez Artefact Adopt AI, nous concevons et organisons des hackathons d'innovation sur des enjeux technologiques et sociétaux majeurs. Notre objectif, en lien avec des grands acteurs publics et privés : réunir étudiants, développeurs, entrepreneurs, chercheurs et experts métiers pour faire émerger, en quelques jours, des idées et des prototypes concrets répondant à des problématiques réelles.

Du 2 au 4 décembre 2026, nos hackathons s'installeront au Grand Palais lors d'Adopt AI, le plus grand salon européen dédié à l'IA, rassemblant des milliers de participants.

Pour nous accompagner dans la communication et l'organisation de nos hackathons – avant, pendant et après Adopt AI, nous recherchons un(e) Assistant(e) Communication & Événementiel.

Les missions

Rattaché(e) à l'équipe et sous la responsabilité de la responsable événementielle et communication, tes missions couvriront les deux piliers majeurs de nos projets :

1. Communication & Contenus

Un rôle au cœur de la stratégie de communication, avec un fort besoin de créativité : de la conception des visuels à l'animation des canaux, une vraie latitude de proposition sera laissée au/à la candidat(e).

  • Création de supports visuels : identité visuelle, création de contenus, kits de communication, newsletters, publications LinkedIn, supports print (kakémonos, signalétique, fonds de stand, goodies).
  • Rédaction & Animation : Rédaction des supports destinés aux participants, intervenants, sponsors et clients. Animation des canaux de communication.
  • Valorisation événementielle : Mise à jour des pages web/présentations et médiatisation des hackathons et temps forts (avant, pendant et après l'événement).

2. Gestion & Production Événementielle

Pré-événement :

  • Coordination avec les différents prestataires (lieu, catering, scénographie, mobilier) et gestion des commandes / goodies.
  • Participation à la construction des documents supports (planning événementiel, agendas/déroulés, staffing, briefs des prestataires).
  • Participation à la gestion et au suivi des livraisons liées à l’événement

Jour J (Pendant l'événement) :

  • Présence sur site pour épauler la régie et l'équipe de production.
  • Coordination logistique des prestataires, flux et livraisons.
  • Accueil et garantie de la meilleure expérience possible pour les participants, sponsors et VIPs.

Post-événement :

  • Suivi du démontage, retours logistiques, bilan budgétaire et facturation.
  • Communication post-événement

Roadmap indicative de la mission

  • Oct. : Amplification des actions de communication & lancement de la logistique événementielle
  • Nov. : Rush Pré-event (communication intensive & dernier sprint de l’organisation opérationnelle)
  • Déc. : Jour J au Grand Palais (présence sur le terrain, gestion live de l’événement)
  • (A confirmer) Janv. : Bilan, REX, valorisation post-event & continuation des projets communication / event

Profil recherché

  • Freelance avec expériences et projets concrets en Communication et Événementiel.

  • Outils & Compétences :
    • Canva : Maîtrise avancée indispensable.
    • Suite Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) & Montage Vidéo : Un véritable plus.
    • Outils bureautiques & collaboratifs : Suite Google / Microsoft, Klaxoon, etc.

  • Langues : Qualités rédactionnelles parfaites et orthographe irréprochable en Français et Anglais (environnement bilingue).

  • Qualités personnelles :
    • Rigueur & organisation : Capable de gérer un budget, un planning et des tâches logistiques avec soin.
    • Créativité & sens esthétique : Force de proposition sur les visuels et concepts.
    • Relationnel & esprit d'équipe : Aisance pour échanger avec des interlocuteurs variés (chefs de projet, prestataires, partenaires, clients).
    • Autonomie & réactivité : Capacité à avancer sur plusieurs sujets en parallèle dans un environnement dynamique.

Ce que cette collaboration t'apportera

  • Une immersion au cœur des enjeux d'Innovation, Data et Intelligence Artificielle.
  • Une vision à 360° de la gestion de projet : de la stratégie de communication à la logistique terrain d'un événement majeur au Grand Palais.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, bienveillante et responsabilisante.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique 

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As Global Director, Mid-Market Onboarding, you will own and scale the onboarding function for Cloudbeds' fastest-growing and most complex customer segment. You'll lead the team responsible for guiding mid-market customers from contract signature through go-live, adoption, and a clean transition to Account Management. You'll build the frameworks, standards, metrics, and team capability that make that experience world-class and repeatable at scale.

You'll inherit a team of dedicated ICs and leads that have been experimenting with new ways to support these customers and improve their experience. Your charter is to get leadership in place and be maniacal about customer experience while building the project-management rigor that complex mid-market deployments demand. You'll be measured on onboarding velocity, deployment quality, customer satisfaction, and the long-term retention impact of a strong start.

Our Onboarding Team:

Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together with a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Every team member is valued and empowered to share feedback, ideas, and insights so we can learn, grow, and improve both as individuals and as a team. Leaders who thrive here are proactive communicators, collaborative problem-solvers, and true customer advocates who enjoy navigating complexity while building the systems and people that scale it.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Mid-Market Onboarding team — including Onboarding Project Managers and senior coaches — setting clear expectations, performance standards, growth paths, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
  • Own end-to-end onboarding outcomes for mid-market customers from sales handoff through go-live, adoption, and transition to Account Management — diagnosing and fixing execution gaps in training quality, error detection, and deployment velocity
  • Build standardized onboarding frameworks, SOPs, and configuration standards for complex multi-property and 25–100+ room deployments that balance customization with scalability
  • Establish and own the metrics that matter: onboarding velocity, deployment quality scores, training completion, CSAT/NPS, and early-lifecycle retention — monitoring portfolio health and intervening early on at-risk projects
  • Own capacity and staffing planning for the division — forecasting demand, balancing workload across the team, and partnering with leadership on headcount decisions
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex or at-risk mid-market deployments and partner with Account Management on clean, trust-preserving handoffs
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management — bridging what gets sold and what gets delivered, and contributing to the broader strategy for how Cloudbeds serves mid-market and enterprise-adjacent customers

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 7+ years in hospitality or hospitality technology, including hands-on customer onboarding or implementation experience and team leadership (time at a hotel, hotel group, or a PMS or hospitality-tech company; OTA or travel-distribution experience on its own does not count)
  • Track record of building or significantly improving onboarding and implementation functions and frameworks
  • Proven people-leadership experience — hiring, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams in a distributed, global environment
  • Strong project-management foundation: scope, milestones, timelines, and risk mitigation applied to complex multi-stakeholder deployments
  • Deep understanding of hotel operations and the complexity of serving multi-property, mid-market hospitality customers
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution — you can design the framework and roll up your sleeves to implement it
  • Data-driven: comfortable with KPIs, dashboards, and using insights to drive decisions

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

  • Additional language fluency (Spanish, Portuguese) at a business-professional level
  • Direct experience onboarding or implementing customers at a hospitality SaaS or PMS company
  • Familiarity with property management systems, payments, or hospitality fintech
  • Experience building onboarding or implementation functions at a scale-up stage company
  • Background working with hotel management companies, small chains, or the consultant ecosystem

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Role

As Head of Global Accounts, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for the commercial relationship with France's most strategic restaurant brands. Your team currently consists of 7 people: Key Account Managers who own brand HQ relationships, and a Client Partner (mid-manager) who manages a team of Key Account Associates covering franchisees across the territory. You report to the Director of Enterprise & Key Accounts, France, and are based in Paris (this is a hybrid role). You are the senior commercial owner for your portfolio — accountable for revenue growth, partner satisfaction, and team excellence. Beyond day-to-day account management, you will play a central role in aligning the organisation to strategic priorities: from contract structuring and joint business planning, to supporting Deliveroo's city expansion strategy by securing anchor restaurant partners in new and relaunching markets. This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.

    • Own the end-to-end commercial growth of Global Accounts in France Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell strategies with major restaurant brands

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Doctolib est une entreprise B Corp engagée à construire ensemble la santé dont nous rêvons tous. Avec 2 900 collaborateurs en France, en Allemagne, en Italie et aux Pays-Bas, nous accompagnons plus de 420 000 professionnels de santé et 90 millions de patients, transformant l'accès aux soins et la prise en charge à travers l'Europe. Nous accélérons désormais notre ambition : devenir le partenaire clinique de référence en Europe, de confiance pour les patients et les professionnels, grâce à la puissance de technologies avancées et de l'IA.

Notre ambition est de construire le système d'exploitation clinique de demain pour l'Europe - offrant des résultats de santé mesurables pour des millions de personnes.

  • Pour les professionnels de santé : Nous réduisons la charge administrative, augmentons la prise de décision clinique grâce à l'IA et permettons de nouveaux modèles de soins.
  • Pour les patients : Nous passons de soins réactifs en cas de maladie à une gestion proactive de leur santé, en donnant aux personnes les moyens de prendre en charge leur santé avec des compagnons numériques de confiance, recommandés par les médecins.

Vos missions

L'hôpital est l'un des segments les plus stratégiques et exigeants de Doctolib. En une décennie, nous avons construit une présence solide auprès des établissements de santé, publics et privés à but non lucratif, avec une suite complète de solutions couvrant l'ensemble du parcours ambulatoire : visibilité de l'offre de soins, planification, prise de rendez-vous, préparation administrative, assistant de consultation IA, téléconsultation, téléexpertise et bien plus encore.

En tant que Head of Hospitals & Home Care, vous prenez la tête d'une équipe d'une quinzaine de personnes, structurée en acquisition et account management, et appuyée par de nombreuses équipes expertes partenaires, notamment Déploiement, Interopérabilité, Product Marketing et Affaires Publiques. Vous êtes le ou la garant(e) de la performance commerciale, de la satisfaction client et de la vision stratégique du segment hospitalier en France, tout en ouvrant la voie à de nouveaux territoires : le médico-social et les soins à domicile.

Votre responsabilité sera de combiner performance à court terme, développement de la base installée et construction d'une vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans pour le segment.

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Salaried & Retail France de Doctolib, en reportant à Maric Philibert, notre VP Sales, Salaried & Retail.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

  • Piloter et atteindre les objectifs de net MRR du segment, sur l'acquisition, l'expansion et la rétention, avec une implication personnelle dans le développement des comptes les plus stratégiques et l'accélération du cross-sell sur les nouvelles solutions, notamment l'Assistant de Consultation et la Téléexpertise.
  • Assurer la satisfaction et l'usage effectif des solutions Doctolib dans les établissements clients, en coordination étroite avec les équipes Déploiement, Interopérabilité et Customer Care.
  • Manager, développer et engager une équipe d'environ 15 personnes, accompagner sa montée en séniorité et renforcer son efficacité grâce à la donnée et aux agents IA.
  • Construire et incarner la vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans du segment, en lien avec la Product Vision de Doctolib et les tendances de marché, en coordination avec les équipes Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques, Communication et Produit.
  • Développer et entretenir les relations institutionnelles clés, notamment avec la FHF, la FEHAP, UNICANCER, la DGOS et les ARS, et piloter les partenariats stratégiques du segment.
  • Explorer et initier les premiers revenus dans les segments médico-social et soins à domicile, en définissant les besoins, la stratégie et les approches tactiques adaptées.
  • Développer une approche structurée de segmentation, d'account planning et de couverture des comptes stratégiques, afin d'augmenter l'adoption, l'expansion, le cross-sell et la rétention.
  • Coordonner les équipes Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques et Partenariats, tout en gardant les priorités clients et terrain au centre des décisions.
  • Représenter Doctolib auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs, institutionnels, politiques, techniques et des principaux réseaux professionnels du secteur.

Votre impact

Au cours des 12 premiers mois, vous aurez établi un diagnostic clair et un plan opérationnel pour le segment, renforcé l'équipe et les managers, amélioré la visibilité sur la performance et créé une nouvelle dynamique autour des comptes stratégiques et des opportunités de croissance.

À deux à cinq ans, la réussite se traduira notamment par :

  • Faire progresser le revenu et doubler la croissance en new ARR annuel via l’upsell (licences des solutions historiques), le cross sell (livraison de solutions autour de l’IA et de la coordination des soins) ainsi que l’acquisition de nouveaux clients dans les segments hospitaliers sous-exploités aujourd’hui , le médico-social, les EHPAD et les soins à domicile.
  • Positionner Doctolib comme une solution complète, de confiance et créatrice de valeur pour les établissements de santé, dans une approche plus partenariale et moins transactionnelle, et accompagner les mouvements de fond du secteur : du curatif au préventif, vers plus de coordination entre professionnels de tous types, la responsabilité populationnelle
  • Construire une équipe stable, plus senior et soutenue par les agents IA, donc en capacité de vendre et d’assurer la satisfaction pour plus de solutions et plus d’établissements, moins dépendante des expertises individuelles.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons un leader senior capable d'agir comme le ou la CEO du segment et d'évoluer avec crédibilité auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs internes et externes.

  • Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative auprès d'établissements de santé, acquise comme fournisseur ou prestataire, éditeur e-santé, acteur de la healthtech, dirigeant d'établissement ou de groupe, institutionnel ou consultant en santé avec une forte dimension commerciale. Vous comprenez les acteurs, les personas, les cultures, les rythmes, les circuits de décision et les enjeux politiques et réglementaires du secteur.
  • Vous avez une expérience de la vente B2B complexe et grands comptes, avec des organisations comprenant de nombreuses parties prenantes et des cycles de vente longs. Vous maîtrisez l'acquisition, la vente de solutions complexes, la gestion de comptes stratégiques, l'expansion, l'adoption et la rétention.
  • Vous apportez une vision business 360° couvrant la stratégie, le go-to-market, l'acquisition, l'expansion, les partenariats, le produit, les opérations et l'account management, sans angle mort.
  • Vous avez managé et développé une organisation d'au moins 10 personnes, idéalement composée de profils hétérogènes, avec un historique de transformation, de montée en séniorité et de développement de managers.
  • Vous savez délivrer des résultats à court terme tout en construisant le segment à moyen et long terme, avec rigueur analytique, gravitas C-level et excellente coordination transverse avec Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques et Partenariats.
  • Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Ce serait un plus si vous aviez aussi :

  • Une expérience des acteurs du médico-social, des EHPAD ou des soins à domicile, ou une forte motivation pour contribuer activement à l'ouverture de ces marchés.
  • Une bonne compréhension des enjeux politiques et réglementaires de la santé numérique, notamment le Ségur du Numérique, l'interopérabilité, les financements publics et les politiques de santé.
  • Une aisance naturelle dans les interactions à dimension institutionnelle ou politique, avec une gravitas adaptée aux interlocuteurs C-level, publics et techniques.
  • Une expérience dans une scale-up, un éditeur e-santé, une direction hospitalière ou de groupe, un acteur institutionnel ou un cabinet de conseil en santé.

Notre offre

  • Une mutuelle avantageuse prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib pour les employés et leurs enfants
  • 25 jours de congés payés et jusqu'à 14 jours de RTT par an 
  • Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care
  • Une politique de travail flexible avec 10 jours par an de télétravail possible depuis les pays de l'Union européenne et le Royaume-Uni 
  • Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,5 € par jour, dont 4,5 € pris en charge par Doctolib
  • Un programme d'intégration complet de 3 mois incluant la Doctolib Academy et diverses formations (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)
  • Une subvention du comité d'entreprise pour le remboursement partiel d'adhésions à des activités sportives ou de loisirs
  • Un remboursement à 50% de l'abonnement aux transports en commun
  • Un mois de congé supplémentaire au congé parental légal grâce au programme "Parent Care"
  • Aide au déménagement en cas de mobilité internationale
  • Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien psychologique renforcé

Processus de recrutement

  • Entretien avec un recruteur (45 min)
  • Entretien avec le VP Sales, Salaried & Retail (1h)
  • Cas pratique (1h30)
  • Entretien avec un pair (optionnel) (45 min)
  • Entretien final avec notre Managing Director France

Détails du poste

  • Contrat permanent (CDI)
  • Temps plein
  • Flexibilité : 3 jours par semaine au bureau minimum
  • Lieu de travail : Levallois-Perret, France
  • Date de début : dès que possible
  • Rémunération : fixe + variable sur objectifs

 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As Healthcare & Life Sciences Principal, Business Development (EMEA), you will partner with EMEA Sales and Sales Engineering leaders to shape and execute the region’s HLS growth strategy. You will connect market opportunity to field execution: prioritizing segments and accounts, developing repeatable vertical and horizontal plays, strengthening the organization and partner ecosystem, and leading critical customer and alliance initiatives. You will be expected to operate comfortably at three levels:

● Strategic: Define where and how Everpure should win in European healthcare and life sciences.

● Organizational: Build the capabilities, coverage, relationships, and operating cadence required to scale.

● Commercial: Personally advance priority opportunities, alliances, and executive relationships to closed business and measurable customer value.

The role requires a combination of HLS credibility, technical fluency in data and AI platforms, commercial ownership, and the ability to influence across country sales, SE, partners, and corporate teams without relying on formal authority.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the Pipeline & Financial Performance: Own the booking targets and financial performance for the segment by developing and executing a multi year strategic growth plan. Drive and scale the overarching pipeline and bookings targets across the EMEA ecosystem, establishing clear qualification criteria and pipeline visibility.  

Define the EMEA Value Proposition: Define and articulate the value proposition for Healthcare & Life Sciences to drive growth and establish Everpure as the industry leader.  

Architect & Execute Joint GTM Plans: Author and launch strategic go-to-market plans with priority partners, aligning internal cross-functional EMEA teams (Partner Account Teams, Core Sales, Alliances, Marketing) to unlock high-potential HLS customer accounts and activate new revenue streams.

Orchestrate Strategic Alliances: Orchestrate strategic vertical alliances and operationalize relationships with key partners to secure reference architectures and joint go to market motions.  

Enable and Mobilize the Partner Ecosystem: Equip sales teams and partners with the specialized tools, training, and playbooks they need to successfully position and sell vertical solutions. Train and align Partner representatives ensuring they can effectively articulate our value proposition, economic differentiation, and technical sizing for healthcare compliance.  

Drive Joint Demand Gen & Thought Leadership: Act as a spokesperson for your vertical vision in customer meetings, industry events, analyst briefings, and media opportunities. Build credibility as a principal advisor by shaping the industry narrative around intelligent data foundations and enterprise AI adoption.

WHAT YOU BRING

HLS & Alliance Expertise: Proven success leading strategic business development or alliance management within the technology sector, with a deep understanding of customers solutions, cloud economics, and the specific regulatory, data, and compliance needs of the EMEA Healthcare and Life Sciences sector.

Cross-Functional Influence & Execution: Develop and execute the global strategy for your segment in partnership with Product Management, Sales, and Engineering teams. A track record of balancing high-level strategy with a "roll-up-your-sleeves" execution mindset, showing a strong ability to build trust and influence executive leaders across partner organizations.

Agile Collaboration & Communication: Outstanding business acumen and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to thriving in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and multi-cultural EMEA environment.

Location & Travel: We operate in a hybrid/field-based model. You will be expected to work effectively from a regional corporate office in a key EMEA market, with the ability to travel 25–40% across the region as business needs require.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Daraus bauen wir das Beratungshaus für den deutschen Mittelstand, und wir bauen es schnell. Diesen Markt gewinnt nicht, wer den besseren Fachaufsatz schreibt, sondern wer als Marke dauerhaft präsent ist und den Markt anführt — bei Unternehmern genauso wie bei den Menschen, die wir für uns gewinnen wollen. Genau diese Marke bauen wir: ikonisch, unverwechselbar, und in dieser Branche gibt es sie noch nicht. Design ist deshalb keine Abteilung am Ende der Kette: Was wir bauen, wird aus einer Designperspektive gedacht. Du bist Grafikdesigner mit außergewöhnlichem visuellem Gespür und einem Portfolio, das für sich spricht. Du kommst aus einer Agentur, einem eigenen Studio oder von einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Du wechselst, weil du dort immer nur einen Teilbereich verantwortest — eine Kampagne, ein Relaunch, eine Strecke im System — und nie die Marke als Ganzes samt der Experience dahinter verantworten und führen darfst. Genau das willst du: die volle visuelle Verantwortung, mit einem Auftraggeber, der dir das Urteil nicht wegnimmt. Die Rolle ist bewusst nach unten offen. Wenn du gerade aus einem starken Gestaltungsstudium oder einer gestalterischen Ausbildung kommst und deine Mappe das visuelle Urteil und die Systemtiefe zeigt, die diese Rolle braucht, bist du hier richtig — du startest dann am unteren Ende der Spanne, arbeitest zunächst an Teilen des Systems und wächst in die volle Verantwortung hinein. Das Portfolio entscheidet, nicht das Jahr des Abschlusses. Bei Vogel findest du beides: Strukturen, die tragen, und ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Kein Konzern-Korsett. Kein Aufbau-Versprechen ohne Boden. Du verantwortest das gesamte visuelle System von Vogel und der weiteren Marken, die daneben entstehen — Print, Digital, Raum, Bewegtbild, Experience. Du setzt selbst um und ziehst Partner dort zu, wo Kapazität oder Spezialisierung es erfordert. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Die Rolle sitzt in München, vor Ort. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in die fachliche Führung des Design- und Brand-Bereichs. Deine Verantwortung Visuelles System und Markenführung Du verantwortest das Designsystem von Vogel — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache, Layout-Prinzipien, Komponenten — und entwickelst es weiter, statt es nur zu verwalten. Du überträgst das System in Content: Social, Publikationen, Whitepaper, Präsentationen, Recruiting-Material. Das System ist erst fertig, wenn andere im Unternehmen damit arbeiten können, ohne dich zu fragen. Du setzt die visuellen Systeme der weiteren Marken auf, die bei Vogel entstehen. Dein Maßstab: Wer drei unserer Touchpoints nebeneinander sieht, erkennt sie ohne Logo als Vogel. Gestaltung über alle Medien Print: Publikationen, Geschäftsausstattung, Mandantenkommunikation, Kampagnenmotive — von der ersten Skizze bis zur Druckfreigabe in deiner Hand. Webdesign: Du gestaltest vogel-beratung.com und die dazugehörigen Seiten weiter, im direkten Austausch mit unserem Webentwickler. Darüber hinaus verantwortest du das Webdesign für alle Standorte und Gesellschaften der Vogel-Gruppe. Eventdesign und räumliche Gestaltung: Standorte, Bühnen, eigene Veranstaltungsformate, Messeauftritte. Du gestaltest, wie Vogel sich anfühlt, wenn man im Raum steht. Experience Design: Du denkst den Weg von Mandanten und Bewerbern als gestaltete Abfolge, nicht als Sammlung einzelner Assets. Kreativ-Steuerung, Partner und Nachwuchs Du steuerst Agenturen, Kreativpartner, Fotografen und Freelancer — Briefing, Auswahl, Qualitätsurteil, Freigabe. Zugeliefert wird Kapazität, die Handschrift bleibt deine. Du steuerst Motion Design von der Konzeption bis zur Abnahme und stellst sicher, dass Bewegtbild aus demselben System kommt wie alles andere. Du leitest unsere Design-Praktikanten und Berufseinsteiger fachlich an, gibst Feedback am Handwerk und baust darauf perspektivisch dein eigenes Team auf. Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt — wer vorankommen will, weil er gut ist, findet hier den Raum dafür, ohne politische Tarnung und ohne Konsens-Theater. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast: Du hast das visuelle System ausgebaut — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache und Komponenten sind erkennbar weiterentwickelt, nicht nur inventarisiert. Du hast vogel-beratung.com überarbeitet, die neuen Seiten sind live. Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für alle Designthemen im Unternehmen — Anfragen laufen bei dir zusammen, statt bei Externen zu landen. Du lieferst konstanten Output an Assets über alle Kanäle, ohne dass Themen liegen bleiben. Die Marke beginnt, deine Handschrift zu tragen. Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast: Das Designsystem ist in Figma so aufgesetzt, dass Content-, Growth- und Recruiting-Themen ohne dich sauber daraus produzieren. Die täglichen Assets aus dem Beratungsalltag — Präsentationen, Slides, Mandantenunterlagen — entstehen automatisiert per KI auf Basis deines Designsystems. Dass das trägt, hängt an sauberer Dokumentation und einem belastbaren technischen Setup: beides liegt bei dir. Das Designsystem und die Assets aller Sub-Marken der Vogel-Gruppe sind ausgebaut und angewendet — jede Marke hat ein eigenes visuelles Fundament, das erkennbar aus derselben Logik kommt. Dein Partner-Setup steht: ausgewählte Agenturen und Kreativpartner, klare Briefing-Standards, Qualitätsurteil bei dir. Motion Design läuft als eigener Produktionsstrang unter deiner Steuerung. Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast: Vogel ist visuell unverwechselbar — im Markt zuordenbar, ohne dass ein Logo nötig ist. Eine neue Marke setzt du visuell in Wochen auf, nicht in Quartalen — das System trägt das, ohne dass du jedes Asset selbst baust. Du hast mindestens einen Junior-Designer eingestellt, eingearbeitet und auf ein Niveau gebracht, auf dem er eigene Strecken trägt. Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt: Der nächste Schritt ist die fachliche Führung von Design und Brand über alle Marken hinweg (IC-Karriere) — das setzt ein visuelles System voraus, das ohne dich trägt, nicht nur zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Wenn du das Team mit aufbaust und führen willst, öffnet sich zusätzlich die Führungslaufbahn. Wir kennen keinen Automatismus „mehr Erfahrung gleich höhere Stufe". Das bringst du mit Erfahrung & Track Record Du hast ein Portfolio auf höchstem Niveau — Grafikdesign, Typografie, Branding-Systeme, visuelles Storytelling. Das Portfolio entscheidet, nicht der Lebenslauf. Du hast in einem professionellen Setup produziert: Agentur mit Design- oder Branding-Fokus, eigenes Studio, oder Inhouse bei einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Berufsjahre sind für uns ein Indiz, kein Kriterium — wir entscheiden an Arbeiten und an Umsetzungsfähigkeit. Du hast Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, visuelle Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares studiert — oder du hast dir das Handwerk selbst beigebracht und kannst das mit Arbeiten belegen, die den Abschluss ersetzen. Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber visuelles Urteil und Umsetzungstiefe mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Konkret: Designer aus einem kleinen Studio ohne große Namen, dessen Arbeiten besser sind als das, was große Agenturen abliefern; Art Director aus einem Feld weit weg von B2B — Mode, Kultur, Gastronomie, Musik — mit systemischem Denken; Architekt oder Szenograf mit ausgeprägtem Gespür für Typografie und Fläche; Autodidakt mit eigenem Magazin, Label oder Projekt, das visuell trägt. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala: das untere Ende steht für den Einstieg direkt nach Studium oder Ausbildung mit überzeugender Mappe, das obere Ende für gestalterische Tiefe im Schwerpunkt, ein System, das ohne dich trägt, und einen erkennbaren Methodenbeitrag — nicht für Führungsspanne. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau — die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen. Skills & Arbeitsweise Du beherrschst die Adobe Creative Cloud auf Produktionsniveau — InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop — und Figma als Systemwerkzeug. Du kannst Webdesign so übergeben, dass es umsetzbar ist. Ein Grundverständnis von HTML und CSS hilft, ist aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast Motion-Grundlagen — genug, um zu briefen, zu steuern und Ergebnisse zu beurteilen. Mehr ist willkommen. Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug — Bildgenerierung, Varianten-Exploration, Retusche, schnelles Durchspielen von Layout-Richtungen. Du denkst ein Designsystem so, dass eine KI verlässlich daraus produzieren kann. Repetitive Aufgaben sind dir ein Reiz zur Automatisierung, kein Schicksal. Du produzierst in kurzen Zyklen und zeigst früh Unfertiges. Lange Abstimmungsschleifen und Präsentations-Choreografie brauchst du nicht. Mindset & Persönlichkeit Du hast Geschmack und erkennst, wann etwas gut ist, ohne dass jemand dir Kriterien vorgibt — und du kannst deine Entscheidung trotzdem begründen, statt dich hinter Geschmack zu verstecken. Du hältst eine gestalterische Position, wenn du überzeugt bist, und lässt sie fallen, wenn das Gegenargument besser ist. Du willst mit Menschen arbeiten, die Design verstehen und nicht erst überzeugt werden müssen, dass es zählt. Die Feedback-Runden gehen hier über die Sache, nicht über Geschmackspolitik. Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen — nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört. Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst Kein Job, in dem du Design an Agenturen abgibst und Reportings durchsiehst. Du produzierst selbst. Partner kommen dazu, wo Kapazität oder Spezialisierung fehlt — nicht anstelle deiner Handschrift. Kein Hochglanz-Agentur-Workflow. Wir iterieren in kurzen Zyklen, entscheiden am Bildschirm und schrauben am Detail selbst. Wer Vorlauf, Abstimmungskaskaden und Präsentations-Rituale braucht, arbeitet hier gegen den Takt. Kein Greenfield-Design in einem leeren Raum. Vogel hat ein bestehendes Erscheinungsbild, laufende Mandantenkommunikation und eine Website, die produktiv ist. Was du baust, muss neben dem laufenden Betrieb funktionieren. Kein Marketing-Korsett, in dem du auf Beförderungen wartest. Wachstum entsteht hier am Beitrag, nicht am Berufsjahr — und nicht daran, wie viele Menschen an dich berichten. Kein Ausstieg in eine 40-Stunden-Woche und kein Remote-First-Setup. Die Intensität bleibt hoch, anders gerichtet und mit deutlich mehr Ownership. Diese Rolle braucht Präsenz in München — Design entsteht hier im Raum mit anderen. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick. 3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren. 7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub? Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. description: Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations. You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. Everything you build is open source and immediately visible. All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. What You’ll Do Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it. Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience. Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations. Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes. Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem. What We’re Looking For Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it. Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems. Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work? Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach. Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects. Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks. CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn. Bonus Points Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation Contributions to popular open source projects, SDKs, or developer tools Experience building developer tooling, CLIs, or client libraries Former founder or early startup experience Active presence in AI/ML developer communities (blog posts, talks, open source) No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply. Projects You Could Own Build and ship a Langfuse integration for an emerging agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, new OTEL-based instrumentation) Design the integration pattern for a new category of AI tools (e.g., voice agents via LiveKit/Pipecat) Create comprehensive quickstart cookbooks that get developers from zero to traced in under 5 minutes Work with the OpenTelemetry community to improve GenAI semantic conventions Maintain and upgrade our most popular integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) as those frameworks ship breaking changes Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. The Role We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps. As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office. What You'll Own AI-native product experiences Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development. Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users. Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction. Prescription and eligibility Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost. Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild. Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge. Recommendation, commitment and finalisation Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting. Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap. Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start. Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel. Metrics and experimentation Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails. Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation. Cross-functional Leadership Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable. Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points. Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch. Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership. What We're Looking For The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner. Must-have experience: Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation). Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards. Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments. Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies. Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts. Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content. AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies. Strong signals we look for: Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context. Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic. Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users. A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise. A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus. How you work: Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities. Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good. Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces. AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work. Not for you if: This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out. description: Lead Systems Engineer We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces. Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle. Lead the definition, ownership, and resolution of system interfaces across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other technical departments. Identify and manage interdependencies, assumptions, constraints, and cross-subsystem impacts as the vehicle design develops. Use MBSE models and related system artefacts to maintain a connected view of vehicle architecture, requirements, and interfaces. Lead cross-disciplinary systems discussions and reviews, bringing forward system-level trade-offs, resolving technical conflicts, and ensuring decisions are clearly recorded. Coordinate technical departments around vehicle-level priorities and help keep subsystem work aligned with the needs of the overall programme. Track system-level issues and interface actions through to resolution, helping establish the conditions for successful vehicle integration and launch. What we’re looking for Strong understanding of model-based systems engineering and its application to complex, multidisciplinary engineering programmes. Strong understanding of rocketry and how vehicle subsystems interact across the complete system. Experience leading systems engineering work, system interfaces, or cross-disciplinary technical efforts on complex engineering projects. A proven track record of successfully completing engineering projects. The ability to maintain a vehicle-level perspective while engaging with technical teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other disciplines. Confidence facilitating technical decisions, managing competing subsystem needs, and driving interface issues toward resolution. description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose We’re looking for an experienced Locum Ultrasound sonographer to join our multidisciplinary team in Birmingham and help to take ultrasounds as part of a clinical research study. This is a key role focused on delivering high-quality, independent assessments. You’ll perform and interpret ultrasound scans of adult women who are receiving a breast ultrasound as part of a clinical study. You will work in conjunction with the principal investigator of the study to ensure that assessments and reports are of research-grade quality. This is a fixed term role that lasts for the duration of the study and is based at our clinics in Birmingham. What You’ll Deliver Perform high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations in line with clinical guidelines and best practices with focus on breast ultrasound Pass on the study-specific acquisition and interpretation qualification task before performing study scans, with certificate filed in the investigational site file. Independently interpret and report ultrasound findings, ensuring timely delivery of results that are uploaded to a standardised electronic case report form. Collaborate with our multidisciplinary research team to help deliver Neko’s clinical trial focused on better understanding risks of breast cancer. Adherence to the study acquisition SOP Equipment QA maintenance logged on-site. Liaise directly with the study PI and research team where needed. Minimum Requirements HCPC-registered diagnostic radiographer (or other HCPC-/NMC-registered healthcare professional), holding a CASE-accredited postgraduate qualification in breast ultrasound (PgCert / PgDip / MSc, or a named CASE-accredited breast ultrasound module. Documented, current breast ultrasound practice, with a minimum of two years’ full-time-equivalent breast scanning. Advanced radiographic experience of reporting autonomously within the NHS Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) or an equivalent quality-assurance framework. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to study participants. Commitment to maintaining high clinical standards and engaging in ongoing professional development. Preferred Experience with previous ultrasound scanning as part of clinical trials Experience with shear-wave elastography acquisition and reporting. Experience with Philips US machines, and decision support software Familiarity with data entry as part of clinical research studies. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
